headline: Sherrock beats Littler in one leg to win £501,000 on Netflix
standfirst: Fallon Sherrock was the 15th challenger to face Luke Littler in Netflix's live show and the first to beat him, winning the £501,000 prize.
body: Fallon Sherrock won £501,000 after beating world champion Luke Littler in a single leg of darts on Netflix's live show Beat Luke Littler at Manchester Central.

Littler had beaten the first 14 challengers, some as young as 14, over about two and a half hours before Sherrock stepped up. The Guardian reported that former Irish youth player Pearse Mackle had come closest before her.

Sherrock's place in the line-up had been criticised because of her record in the women's game and at the World Championship. She told the Press Association that the build-up had been tough, but that she was "happy to overcome all the hate" and that she met the criteria because she has never held a Tour Card.
PDC president Barry Hearn backed her inclusion, saying the event wanted "excellence competing against excellence", according to BBC Sport.

The event, hosted by Gary Lineker and Richard Osman, was Netflix's first live entertainment event in the UK. Dartsnews reported that Littler was gracious in defeat and suggested Netflix should run the show again in 2027.
